entries.question: And how will I know if my lab reports are ready or not ??
entries.answer:
Since KGMU does not have a central online tracking portal for patient lab reports, you will generally be given a specific date and time for collection when you give your sample.

1. **Check your SMS:** If your mobile number was registered correctly at the time of sample collection, you may receive an SMS notification once the report is processed.

3. **Contact the hospital:** You can reach out to the specific department or check with your treating unit during your follow-up visit. 

For general inquiries, you can contact the PRO Office at **9415007710** or the helpline at **0522-2258880**.

entries.question: What happens if nodal officer does not verify my documents online timely
entries.answer:
If your documents are not verified online by the nodal officer within the stipulated MCC deadline, it can jeopardize your seat allotment for that round, as successful online verification is mandatory to confirm admission. 

To protect your candidature:
1. **Preserve Proof of Attempt:** Keep clear records (screenshots of emails sent, call logs, and your MCC allotment letter) showing that you submitted your documents and attempted to contact the nodal officer and university timely.
2. **Contact MCC Authorities:** Immediately inform the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) support/helpdesk about the delay from the university's end so they have an official record of your situation.
3. **In-Person Escalation:** If feasible, visiting the KGMU campus in person remains the fastest way to get the verification processed immediately.

entries.question: Opd ka parga kisee banya
entries.answer:
OPD की पर्ची (Registration Slip) बनवाने के निम्नलिखित तरीके उपलब्ध हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (ORS पोर्टल):** आप [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) वेबसाइट के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं और ₹50 का शुल्क भुगतान करके अपनी पर्ची डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

*नोट: OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है और काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक बंद हो जाता है। भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से ऑनलाइन बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है।*

entries.question: Since we are UG bonded doctors of UP we have out 10/12 certificate in UG college…how would we take PG admission
entries.answer:
If you are a UP UG-bonded doctor and your original 10th and 12th certificates are deposited with your UG college/authorities due to the bond, you can typically use the following approach for PG admission:

1. **Official Receipt/Acknowledgment:** Obtain an official certificate, receipt, or letter from your UG college stating that your original 10th and 12th certificates are currently deposited with them under the service bond terms.
2. **Attested Copies:** Carry attested photocopies of your 10th and 12th certificates along with the official custody letter from your UG college during the verification process.
3. **Inform Counseling Authorities / Nodal Officer:** Explain your bond status clearly to the verifying authority or your nodal officer so they can accept the alternative documentation and official acknowledgment in lieu of the physical originals.

For further specific guidelines regarding admissions, please check the [KGMU Admissions Page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).
